title: IMAP poller and raw email archive
lead: Poll the dedicated mailbox with stdlib `imaplib` and archive raw messages for (re)parsing (O1, O3).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Archiving raw emails means parsers can improve later and re-run over history.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
1. Poll interval (recommend 30 minutes)?
2. After archiving: leave the message on the server (recommended), or move it to an "imported" folder?

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/larder/ingest/imap.py`
- `src/larder/migrations/000N_orders.sql` (raw_email, order, order_line)
- `tests/test_imap.py` (fake IMAP server or an `imaplib` stub)

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. `IMAP4_SSL` connection; credentials from the secrets file; read-only `select`.
2. UID-based incremental fetch; store the raw bytes in `emails/` and a row in `raw_email`.
3. Route to a store by sender/subject rules from config (portability).
4. Schedule it in the same scheduler as recipe sync.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Tests pass; against the real mailbox, the samples are archived exactly once.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
